AI 辅助爬取封面歌词: 开启后，当自动爬取因歌名对不上而失败（搜索无候选 / 低分不敢采纳）时，自动用 AI 规范化歌名再重跑一次公开数据源检索，补齐封面与歌词。仅在失败时触发，会多一次 AI 调用（按次计费）；AI 只纠正歌名，封面与歌词仍来自公开数据源并过同曲校验，不会写入编造内容
AI-assisted cover & lyrics fetch: When automatic fetching fails because the track name does not match (no search hits / low score), AI normalizes the track name and public sources are re-queried once to fill in cover art and lyrics. Only triggered on failure; costs one extra AI call. AI only corrects the name — cover and lyrics still come from public sources and pass identity checks, so no fabricated content is written.
